text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have progressive swelling and pain in your right ring finger; to begin my evaluation, how long have these symptoms been present and what activities seem to trigger them?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gamekeeper's Thumb (Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injury of the MCP Joint)

The mechanism of injury (finger hyperextension against resistance during a football pull) and the location of swelling/pain in the ring finger (where the ulnar collateral ligament is most vulnerable at the MCP joint) are highly specific. Have you noticed any instability or "clunking" sensation when you actively try to bend your finger at the knuckle?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
